assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.description: Ask about the app's data. Changes only happen when you accept them.
assistant.hint: Ask about the app's data. The assistant can look up data, draw charts and propose changes, which show up as cards for you to accept or reject.

disabled.title: Assistant is off
disabled.body: An admin can turn it on in the settings.

delete.title: Delete conversation?
delete.body: The conversation and its proposals will be deleted.

settings.title: Assistant
settings.description: Language model used by the assistant. Off by default.
settings.systemPromptHint: Added to the base instructions: tone, business context, what to avoid.
settings.anthropicHint: The key lives in the server's ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable, never here.
